info.name: Smart Factory API
info.description:
ITEC 116 Final Project - Automated Smart Factory and Production Line Tracking System.

Run "1. Auth > Login as Admin" first. Logins and create requests save tokens and IDs into collection variables automatically. The default Admin login matches ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env.example; change the adminEmail / adminPassword variables if yours differ.

request.description: A1 - Public. Saves the token to {{adminToken}} automatically. Run this first.
Logs out a separate, fresh Admin token (made in the Pre-request script) so your main {{adminToken}} keeps working. The test then shows that the logged-out token is rejected with 401.

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: pm.variables.get('adminEmail'), password: pm.variables.get('adminPassword') }) },
pm.test('Logged-out token is now rejected (401)', () => pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(401));

request.description: Admin only. 409 means it already exists (fine). Also logs in and saves {{supervisorToken}}.

exec: // Also logs in as the Supervisor and saves {{supervisorToken}}
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: pm.variables.get('supervisorEmail'), password: pm.variables.get('supervisorPassword') }) },

request.description: Admin only. 409 means it already exists (fine). Also logs in and saves {{operatorToken}}.

exec: // Also logs in as the Operator and saves {{operatorToken}}
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: pm.variables.get('operatorEmail'), password: pm.variables.get('operatorPassword') }) },

item.name: #1 Get production lines filtered by status

request.description: The Pre-request script creates a temporary line first, so your main demo line is not deleted.

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ lineName: 'Temp Line ' + Date.now(), location: 'Temporary' }) },

item.name: #7 Get machines of a production line
#8 Get machines filtered by line and status

request.description: The Pre-request script creates a temporary machine first, so your main demo machine is not deleted.

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ machineName: 'Temp Machine ' + Date.now(), machineType: 'Temp', productionLineId: Number(pm.variables.get('productionLineId')) }) },

item.name: Delete line that has machines (409 rule)

request.description: Business rule: a production line with machines cannot be deleted.
The Pre-request script creates a temporary product first, so your main demo product is not deleted.

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ productName: 'Temp Product ' + Date.now(), productType: 'Temp', targetQuantity: 1 }) },

request.description: Operator or Supervisor only. Uses {{operatorToken}}. Saves {{recordId}}.

item.name: #15 Admin cannot create a record (403 RBAC)

request.description: Separation of duties: Admin does not encode daily output.
Admin or Supervisor. The Pre-request script creates a temporary record (as Operator) first.

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ productId: Number(pm.variables.get('productId')), machineId: Number(pm.variables.get('machineId')), quantityProduced: 1, defectiveQuantity: 0, dateTime: new Date().toISOString(), remarks: 'Temporary' }) },

request.description: Operator or Supervisor only. Also updates the machine's current status (one transaction). Saves {{logId}}.

item.name: #16 Get machine logs by machine and status
